Subject: POC Kickoff & Timeline  Redwood POC for Acme Industries

Hi Samantha  great to speak today. Thanks for the time and for walking us through Acme's evaluation priorities. Per our call, I wanted to recap the proposed success criteria, basic evaluation plan, and an initial timeline so we can align on owners and next steps.

High-level success criteria (draft)  please confirm or adjust:
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 300ms on your 8k token baseline for the primary prompt set
- Cost: Total inference token cost target <= $0.02 per 1k tokens for batch workload (with recommended batching/quantization)
- Quality: >= 92% acceptable responses on 200 seeded prompts (clarity and accuracy)
- Reliability: <1% error rate during business hours

Evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): Exchange datasets and key prompt sets; Redwood to provision sandbox model endpoint
- Week 1: Kickoff + initial smoke tests (throughput/latency checks)
- Weeks 2-4: Feature validation and workload-driven tests; weekly check-ins to review results
- Week 5: Final readout and decision (internal scoring vs success criteria)

Proposed dates (flexible):
- Kickoff: Tue, Mar 9, 2026  9:00-10:00 PT
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 9:00-9:30 PT (Mar 16, Mar 23, Mar 30)
- Final readout: Fri, Apr 2, 2026  11:00-12:00 PT

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (poc lead), Vivek Kulkarni (solutions eng), Marcus Lin (customer success)
- Acme: Samantha Liu (product), Ben Porter (platform engineering)

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (success criteria + prompt set checklist), poc_kickoff_agenda.pdf (kickoff agenda + roles).

Next steps:
1) Confirm stakeholders and kickoff date/time
2) Share the dataset link for pre-kickoff ingestion (S3 or SharePoint link)
3) I will send a calendar invite for the kickoff once we lock the time

Thanks  looking forward to getting started.

Best,
